purpose: Small hand-authored synthetic smoke evaluation. These are not fetched sources, expert labels, a representative test set or measured worker outcomes.
hypothesis: The two direct manufacturing inspection passages should rank above the two unrelated passages. Ambiguous passages require human review, regardless of score.

cases.text: In a synthetic electronics factory example, automated optical inspection flags suspected surface defects. A quality inspector reviews false alarms and missed defects, records the decision, and escalates recurring errors for root cause analysis.

A synthetic manufacturing quality team compares caliper measurements and inspection records across production batches. Inspectors investigate defect trends, check measurement consistency and document corrective actions before releasing a batch.

A synthetic research abstract describes an image anomaly detection model that performs well on a small visual benchmark. It provides no factory deployment evidence, occupational task analysis, Malaysian demand data or worker qualification requirements.

A synthetic article uses the words industrial inspection and automated optical inspection as examples of technical vocabulary. Its actual subject is how a language model translates marketing copy; it presents no manufacturing inspection method or deployment.

In a synthetic online retail example, a chatbot answers customer questions about returns, shipping addresses and discount codes. The store evaluates conversation satisfaction and whether buyers locate their order history.

A synthetic gardening guide explains how to select balcony herbs, water seedlings and prepare potting soil. It recommends matching sunlight exposure to the plants and keeping a weekly watering calendar.
